candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment 503 root cause (config, dependency, or crash) not established; payment metrics excluded from context.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502 propagating from order 502, which stems from payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations; payment logs confirm repeated 503s. Inventory/redis calls succeed. Bounded to payment-side server error.
